idempotencyDiagnosis.cause: First contact submission changes cart-only keyK0 to contact-aware keyK1 via custom handler global write. Sequence retains captured context._global; evaluateExpression attempts state.get()._global although state.get() returns global contents directly. API body therefore sends priorK0; next rendered retry sendsK1. A lost upstream201 leaves committed inquiry underK0 and cart removed, so retry underK1 conflicts.
idempotencyDiagnosis.diagnostic: Isolated source handler simulation using node--experimental-strip-types and mocked local state/storage only, no app/API/auth; preparedKeyChanged/latestGlobalUndefined/firstWireUsesInitialKey/retryWireUsesPreparedKey/wireKeysDiffer alltrue. Browser proof belongs to lead actual execution.
idempotencyDiagnosis.proposal: Honor direct state.get() global contract in ActionDispatcher global refresh, or pass custom handler returned key through sequence $prev/resultTo local before apiCall. Freeze original submission cart IDs/contact/key across response loss and reload, and verify retry sameID/no duplicate/reservation.
